affectedCopies: Regulation and Obligation compliance-library registry (new horizontal-pack rows)

migration.name: 20260731120000_add_business_context_data_handling
migration.backfill: Additive only: adds BusinessContext.dataHandling TEXT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[]. No backfill — existing rows take the empty-array default, which classifies data-handling-gated regulations as 'review' (undeclared) rather than silently applying or hiding them. No column is dropped or rewritten; no row is deleted. The horizontal-pack Regulation/Obligation rows are added idempotently by the seed (upsert by regulationId / find-by-reference), never mutating or removing existing compliance records.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Additive nullable-safe array column with an empty default. Existing rows are untouched and remain valid; the field is operator-declared at setup and freely editable. No lifecycle transition, no supersession, no deletion.

fields.reason: Captures the closed DATA_HANDLING_PREDICATES an org declares about what it does with data (processes-personal-data, sends-marketing, deploys-automated-decisioning, …). It is the trigger that scopes horizontal regulations (privacy, breach, AI, marketing, accessibility) to the company, and gives the pre-existing handlesCardPayments flag its first consumer via a resolve-time bridge to handles-card-data.
fields.provenance: BI-242F344C; kernel principle_decide chose data-handling-predicate (composite 15.05, high confidence); research determination cited per seeded regulation row.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Additive seed content: 18 horizontal Regulation rows + their Obligation rows, upserted idempotently by stable regulationId / obligation reference. Statutory rows use sourceType 'external'; SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / NIST AI RMF use sourceType 'framework' (contractual/voluntary, not law). No existing regulation or obligation is modified or removed.

fields.reason: Each horizontal regulation gates on a data-handling predicate (or an EU/UK nexus), evaluated by the generic regulationApplies classifier, so it surfaces only for an install whose declared profile matches — never as blanket noise.
fields.provenance: BI-242F344C research determination with per-row source citations; classifier + gate unit tests.
